svg.title: SDLC Agent Pipeline — GitHub Copilot Workflow
svg.desc: Flow diagram showing the SDLC pipeline executing in two modes: Copilot Chat Agent Mode for Steps 0-7, and Copilot Coding Agent via GitHub Issues for Steps 8-13, with four human checkpoint gates.
svg.text: PRD to PR · Two execution modes · Four human checkpoints
Review requirements + clarifications · Answer all blocking questions
Approve architecture · Accept or dismiss risks
Approve stories and tasks · Adjust scope / priority as needed
Resolve all BLOCKING + SECURITY-BLOCKING findings before continuing
Full traceability PRD → stories → specs → code → tests → PR
⚠ Human approval required before merge — no auto-merge
